failures.observed: Three first read-only probe commands invoked the unavailable bare python alias and exited before reading state, credential values, or source values.
failures.root_cause: The desktop shell exposes the bundled interpreter only through its absolute python3 path.
failures.correction: Use /Users/niyufei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3 for every Campaign083 command; the state and credential-existence probes were then rerun without printing the secret. The three commands share one interpreter-resolution root cause and are one infrastructure-failure entry.

failures.observed: The first bundled-runtime invocation of scripts/a_share_data_pipeline.py data-root exited with ModuleNotFoundError: requests before resolving the local data root.
failures.root_cause: The isolated bundled runtime initially lacked the repository runtime dependency requests.
failures.correction: Install requests into the isolated runtime and rerun the same local-only data-root command successfully; it resolved /Volumes/DIsk/Disk-Coding/qlib/data and issued no provider request.

failures.observed: The first no-value static reconstruction import stubbed pyarrow itself but not pyarrow.dataset and exited before reconstructing the prior factor library.
failures.root_cause: The temporary import stub was incomplete.
failures.correction: Extend the temporary import surface and continue the static reconstruction without reading candidate, comparator, daily-price, or forward-return values.

failures.observed: The second no-value static reconstruction import reached the data module and exited because requests was still absent.
failures.root_cause: The temporary import environment had not stubbed or installed requests.
failures.correction: Complete the no-value import and later install the declared runtime dependencies; Campaign083 synthetic protocol tests then reconstructed all 114 complete definitions and all 112 numeric comparators.

failures.observed: A zsh search command used an unmatched requirements*.txt glob and exited nonzero after reporting the new file hashes.
failures.root_cause: zsh nomatch expanded a file pattern that has no matching repository file.
failures.correction: Search only explicit existing dependency files; pyproject.toml confirmed pyarrow, pytest, and scipy<=1.15.3.

failures.observed: The first synthetic suite produced 10 passes and one failure: the strict-count fixture expected four innovations but its afternoon tail reverted from 200 to 100, creating an unintentional fifth strict new low.
failures.root_cause: The test fixture initialized both halves at 100 and changed only four afternoon elements; the implementation correctly counted the later 200-to-100 frontier break.
failures.correction: Initialize the entire afternoon half at 200 before injecting its intended strict low, strict high, and ties. The formula and implementation were unchanged; all 11 tests then passed.

failures.observed: The first Black check reported both new files needed formatting and warned that the repository target version exceeded the Python 3.12 runtime parser.
failures.root_cause: The copied prevalue implementation had not yet been mechanically formatted and Black inherited a newer target-version setting.
failures.correction: Run Black with the explicit prevalue-safe --target-version py312 option, then require its check to leave both files unchanged. No factor semantics changed.

failures.observed: The first Ruff check reported a non-executable shebang, two equivalent running-bound update forms, and five redundant int(len(...)) casts.
failures.root_cause: The newly copied runner had not yet received its executable bit or Campaign083-specific lint cleanup.
failures.correction: Set the runner executable bit, express the running bounds with max/min, remove only redundant len casts, and rerun Ruff, Black, py_compile, and all 11 synthetic tests successfully. The factor formula and gates were unchanged.
